item.oldrepublic.watch_holocron.desc: Lent by Keeper Ansa for study. It hums, faintly, when it is far from the Greenwatch.
title.oldrepublic.wayfarer.desc: Tessaly Arn gave you her mantle at Courier's Fall. The road was always yours.
turning.oldrepublic.cold.jedi: There is nothing I can teach you now that you would want to learn. Go on. Your Overseer is waiting.
turning.oldrepublic.cold.sith: You chose the Watch. Go and be their problem, and do not make yourself mine.
turning.oldrepublic.cond.not_held: The prisoners are not in their cells
turning.oldrepublic.offer.later: The offer will come again in %s days if you stay as you are.
turning.oldrepublic.offer.final: That was your last refusal. No one will bring the offer again until your alignment leaves this band and comes back to it.
turning.oldrepublic.offer.not_you: This messenger was not sent for you
turning.oldrepublic.crystal.name: Saelen's Crystal
turning.oldrepublic.reason.fall_task: Gave the Watch holocron to the Empire
turning.oldrepublic.rite.refund: Half of what you spent on your old path comes back to you: %s skill points.
turning.oldrepublic.fall.task.start: A Gift for the Empire: borrow the Watch holocron from Keeper Ansa at the Greenwatch on Selvaren, and carry it to Overseer Kaddor at the Proving on Varkhast.
turning.oldrepublic.fall.holocron_given: Keeper Ansa lends you the Watch holocron. Carry it to Overseer Kaddor at the Proving on Varkhast, and do not let it go.
turning.oldrepublic.fall.no_holocron: You are not carrying the Watch holocron
turning.oldrepublic.fall.no_room: You have no room for the holocron
turning.oldrepublic.fall.taken_back: The holocron found its way home without you. If you still want to study it, come and ask me again.
turning.oldrepublic.fall.delivered: Overseer Kaddor takes the Watch holocron. Master Saelen will know soon.
turning.oldrepublic.fall.confront.arrive: I know where the holocron went. I wanted to hear it from you, but I think I already have.
turning.oldrepublic.fall.confront.talk: I won't raise a blade against you. Sit with me, and tell me why.
turning.oldrepublic.fall.confront.releas: Then I'll go. Whatever you become, I taught you once. I'll remember that part.
turning.oldrepublic.fall.confront.trophy: Take it, then. I'll find my way home without it.
turning.oldrepublic.fall.rite.arrive: So. You are still standing. Good. Come here; there are words to be said.
turning.oldrepublic.fall.rite.done: You knelt to the Overseer. Your path is now %s.
turning.oldrepublic.return.task.start: Amends: free the three Republic prisoners held at the Imperial detention post on Varkhast, walk them to your ship, and fly them to a Greenwatch pad bay on Selvaren.
turning.oldrepublic.return.freed.fight: The guards are down and the cells are open. The prisoners follow you: walk them to your ship.
turning.oldrepublic.return.freed.trick: The warden opens the cells. The prisoners follow you: walk them to your ship.
turning.oldrepublic.return.freed.talk: The warden opens the cells. The prisoners follow you: walk them to your ship.
turning.oldrepublic.return.prisoner.free: We're out? Then lead the way to your ship, and quickly.
turning.oldrepublic.return.prisoner.held: Get us out of here. The warden has the keys, and the guards have their orders.
turning.oldrepublic.return.prisoner.foll: Right behind you. Where's your ship?
turning.oldrepublic.return.prisoner.than: Solid ground and friendly faces. We won't forget this.
turning.oldrepublic.return.aboard: All three prisoners are aboard. Land at a Greenwatch pad bay on Selvaren.
turning.oldrepublic.return.not_here: The prisoners stay aboard: land at a Greenwatch pad bay on Selvaren.
turning.oldrepublic.return.delivered: The prisoners are safe at the Greenwatch. Overseer Sorn will hear of it.
turning.oldrepublic.return.restart: The prisoners are back in their cells. Start again at the detention post on Varkhast.
turning.oldrepublic.return.confront.arri: You emptied an Imperial post and flew its prisoners to the Watch. I have come to collect what I am owed.
turning.oldrepublic.return.confront.talk: No blades. Not today. Say what you came to say.
turning.oldrepublic.return.confront.rele: Mercy. You will regret it before I do. Go to your Watch.
turning.oldrepublic.return.confront.trop: That blade was older than you are. Leave me the pieces.
turning.oldrepublic.return.rite.arrive: I told you the door was never locked. I'm glad I was right.
turning.oldrepublic.return.rite.done: The Watch welcomes you. Your path is now %s.
turning.oldrepublic.rank4.ready.independ: Ready: the Compass waits at Courier's Fall.
turning.oldrepublic.rank4.req.title: The Pathfinder title
turning.oldrepublic.rank4.req.no_path: No fourth rank on this path
turning.oldrepublic.rank4.deeds.hint: Great deeds: the Long Hymn cleared; Ulvaine's echo defeated three times; five space bounties; five contracts on Ghessar or Tyrvann.
turning.oldrepublic.rank4.deeds.hint.sit: Great deeds: the Long Hymn cleared; Ulvaine's echo defeated three times; five space bounties; five contracts on Ghessar or Tyrvann; Ulvaine's writ held.
turning.oldrepublic.rank4.at_compass: Stand by the Compass's pedestal at Courier's Fall
turning.oldrepublic.rank4.master.after: Master. It suits you less than you think, and more than you fear.
turning.oldrepublic.rank4.darth.after: Darth %s. Wear the name as though you earned it. You did.
turning.oldrepublic.rank4.wayfarer.after: Tessaly Arn's mantle is yours. Title earned: %s.
turning.oldrepublic.rank4.reissued: You are given another %s. The next can be issued tomorrow.
dialogue.oldrepublic.turn_fall_offer.off: %s. Overseer Sorn sent me, and he does not send me lightly. The Overseer says you have stopped pretending. He would like to stop pretending too.
dialogue.oldrepublic.turn_fall_offer.opt: What does he want from me?
dialogue.oldrepublic.turn_fall_offer.why: A gift, to begin with. The Watch keeps an old holocron at the Greenwatch on Selvaren, and Keeper Ansa still trusts you. Borrow it, and carry it to Overseer Kaddor at the Proving on Varkhast. After that the Overseer will come to you himself.
dialogue.oldrepublic.turn_fall_offer.acc: Then hear the rest; he told me to say it plainly. When this is done you kneel to him. The Order will not take you back as you were, and what it gave you will leave you. No one falls twice. Still listening?
dialogue.oldrepublic.turn_fall_offer.opt: I am. Tell him his gift is coming.
dialogue.oldrepublic.turn_fall_offer.dec: He will not be pleased. He is patient, though. If nothing changes in you, someone will come again in a few days. Shall I tell him no?
dialogue.oldrepublic.turn_fall_offer.gon: Whatever the Overseer wanted, it isn't for you any more. Forget you saw me.
dialogue.oldrepublic.turn_return_offer.o: %s? Master Saelen asked me to find you. She says the door was never locked.
Why would she want me back?
dialogue.oldrepublic.turn_return_offer.w: She said you'd ask that. She said to tell you about three Republic prisoners held at an Imperial detention post on Varkhast. You know the Empire's posts better than any of us. Get them out and fly them to the Greenwatch. That's where it starts.
dialogue.oldrepublic.turn_return_offer.a: She wanted me to say this part plainly. When it's done the Empire won't have you back, and Overseer Sorn will come for what he thinks you owe. What the Empire gave you stays behind, and no one comes back twice. Are you still coming?
dialogue.oldrepublic.turn_return_offer.o: I am. I'll find the post.
dialogue.oldrepublic.turn_return_offer.d: She said you might. She also said the door stays unlocked. If you feel the same in a few days, I'll come and ask again. Shall I tell her no?
dialogue.oldrepublic.turn_return_offer.g: Sorry. I think Master Saelen's message was for someone else after all.
dialogue.oldrepublic.turn_ansa.greet: You look like someone with a question. Ask it; the Greenwatch has time today.
dialogue.oldrepublic.turn_ansa.opt.study: I'd like to study the Watch holocron.
dialogue.oldrepublic.turn_ansa.study: The Watch holocron? Half the Watch would tell you it never leaves the Greenwatch. But you're one of us, and Master Saelen speaks well of you. Study it somewhere quiet, and bring it back when you're done.
dialogue.oldrepublic.turn_ansa.opt.take: Thank you, Keeper. I'll take good care of it.
dialogue.oldrepublic.turn_ansa.lent: It hums when it's far from home. Don't let that worry you; it always settles. And it always comes back.
dialogue.oldrepublic.turn_ansa.carrying: Is the holocron treating you well? Take your time with it. It has waited a long while for a careful reader.
dialogue.oldrepublic.turn_kaddor.gift: So the rumour walks in on its own feet. Sorn said a Jedi would bring me something of the Watch's. Is that it in your pack?
dialogue.oldrepublic.turn_kaddor.taken: Old work, and careful work. The Watch never deserved its own treasures. Go home, and wait. Whatever comes for you there, you have earned it.
dialogue.oldrepublic.turn_kaddor.waiting: Sorn told me to expect a Jedi carrying something of the Watch's. You have the first part right. Come back with the rest.
dialogue.oldrepublic.turn_warden.post: This is an Imperial detention post, and I am its warden. Whoever you are, you have no business with the people in those cells.
dialogue.oldrepublic.turn_warden.opt.tri: [Mind Trick] You will open the cells and forget we spoke.
dialogue.oldrepublic.turn_warden.opt.tal: No one needs to get hurt over this. Let them go.
dialogue.oldrepublic.turn_warden.who: Republic prisoners: a pilot, a medic and a surveyor. Spies, says the report. Lost, says the pilot. I don't write the reports.
dialogue.oldrepublic.turn_warden.tricked: The cells. Yes. I was about to open the cells. Take them, and I'll... I'll finish my rounds.
dialogue.oldrepublic.turn_warden.talked: Nobody on Varkhast will thank me for keeping three strays, and nobody needs to bleed over them. Take them and go. I never saw you.
dialogue.oldrepublic.turn_warden.empty: The cells are empty, and I have a report to write that I would rather not. Move along.
dialogue.oldrepublic.turn_last_lesson.yi: Enough. I taught you that guard; I should have known you'd turn it on me. Ansa trusted you because I did. That is mine to carry, not hers. So. What now?
dialogue.oldrepublic.turn_last_lesson.ta: I won't draw on you. I came so that someone would say it to your face: the Watch's holocron sits in an Imperial vault, and Ansa trusted you because I did. That is mine to carry, not hers. So. What now?
dialogue.oldrepublic.turn_last_lesson.op: Go home, Master. I won't follow you.
dialogue.oldrepublic.turn_last_lesson.tr: You would take it from my hand? I carried that crystal before you were born. Take it, then. It will not sing for you the way it sang for me.
dialogue.oldrepublic.turn_last_lesson.op: No. Keep it, and go home.
dialogue.oldrepublic.turn_last_lesson.la: Not now. We'll talk, you and I. Not yet.
Hold. Hold. You fight like the Watch now; I hoped they would ruin you more slowly. You emptied an Imperial post and flew its prisoners to Selvaren. I came to collect what I am owed. It seems I will leave without it. Well?

No blades. I am too old to bleed for a point of pride, and you are too stubborn to let me make one. You emptied an Imperial post and flew its prisoners to Selvaren. I came to collect what I am owed. Well?
Go back to your camp, Overseer. We're finished.
My blade? Break it, if you can. I will have another made, and I will keep the pieces of this one, so I remember why.
Not now. You will know when I have come to collect.
dialogue.oldrepublic.turn_kneel.kneel: So. The Jedi who stopped pretending. Saelen came for you, and you are still standing; that is answer enough. Kneel, and I will say the words.
dialogue.oldrepublic.turn_kneel.new_blad: You broke my blade once, on another road. I had another made, and I kept the pieces of the first so I would remember why. Kneel anyway. I will say the words.
dialogue.oldrepublic.turn_kneel.cost: Everything the Order gave you. Its powers leave you. What you bought in its tree is gone, and half of it comes back to spend again. If they made you a Knight or more, you kneel as an apprentice and earn your rank twice. The Order will call you a traitor, and Saelen will not speak to you again. That is the price. It is not a high one.
dialogue.oldrepublic.turn_kneel.done: Rise, Sith. The Empire remembers who serves it well. It remembers longer who does not.
dialogue.oldrepublic.turn_kneel.later: Not yet. When I have words for you, you will hear them.
dialogue.oldrepublic.turn_welcomed.welco: Sorn came for you, and you're still here. Good. The Watch doesn't ask you to forget what you were. It asks you to keep watch with us. Will you?
dialogue.oldrepublic.turn_welcomed.new_c: I found another crystal. It isn't the one you took, and I've stopped looking at my hands as if it were. That's all I'll say about it. The Watch asks you to keep watch with us. Will you?
dialogue.oldrepublic.turn_welcomed.cost: What the Empire gave you doesn't come with you. Its powers leave you. What you bought in its tree is gone, and half of it comes back to spend again. If they made you a Lord or more, you begin again as an apprentice and earn it with us. The Empire will call you a traitor, and Sorn will not speak to you again. I'm sorry for that part. Only that part.
dialogue.oldrepublic.turn_welcomed.done: Welcome home. You'll find it smaller than you remember, and kinder than you expect.
dialogue.oldrepublic.turn_welcomed.later: Not yet. Sit with me another day.
dialogue.oldrepublic.rank4_saelen.letter: A letter came from the Council on Tython today. It's about you. Sit; this is the part where I read it to you.
dialogue.oldrepublic.rank4_saelen.master: The Council names you a Master of the Order, %s. And the first thing a Master learns is how little that changes. The frontier still needs watching, and you still sit with me when you can.
dialogue.oldrepublic.rank4_saelen.not_re: Nothing from the Council for you yet. When it comes, you'll hear it from me first.
dialogue.oldrepublic.rank4_sorn.writ: A writ from the Dark Council, sealed in black wax, with your name on it. I will spare you the titles. You are to be Darth, and the Council offers six names, as is the custom. Choose one. It will outlive you.
dialogue.oldrepublic.rank4_sorn.opt.name: Read me the names.
dialogue.oldrepublic.rank4_sorn.names: The first three. Say one and it is yours.
dialogue.oldrepublic.rank4_sorn.opt.name: Darth %s.
dialogue.oldrepublic.rank4_sorn.confirm: Darth %s. The Council will write it in its books, and every Sith on the frontier will learn to say it carefully. Is that your name?
dialogue.oldrepublic.rank4_sorn.not_read: Nothing from the Council has your name on it. When something does, I will not keep it from you. Probably.
dialogue.oldrepublic.rank4_compass.echo: The Compass warms under your hand, and Tessaly Arn's figure stands over the pedestal again. "You named yourself here once. Since then you have walked roads I never found."
dialogue.oldrepublic.rank4_compass.mantl: "I wore this mantle from the Watch's gardens to the tombs and back, more times than I can count. Take it. Wear it out. The road was always yours."
dialogue.oldrepublic.rank4_compass.quiet: The Compass is quiet. Whatever it waits for, it is not here yet.
